newsitem.title: USA: TriNet gets $30 Million Cash Settlement.
newsitem.headline: TriNet gets $30 Million Cash Settlement.

text.p: TriNet Corporate Realty Trust Inc said it received a $30 million cash settlement from Mac Frugal's Bargains Close-outs Inc for termination of a lease on a New Orleans warehouse/distribution property.
After using part of the settlement to pay off debt, it will result in a fourth quarter gain of $0.18 a share.
The property was gutted by fire on March 21, 1996.
The settlement includes proceeds for the casualty of the building and compensation to TriNet for termination of the lease, which was originally set to expire in 2009.
TriNet will use $20 million to pay down a $75 million REMIC term loan, while the balance will go to reducing borrowings on a revolving credit facility and acquisitions.

TriNet will recognize an extraordinary gain of about $3.1 million from compensation for the property casualty, and an extraordinary loss of about $0.6 million due to early debt extinguishment. This will result in a gain of about $0.18 per weighted average common share during the fourth quarter of 1996. In addition, the settlement includes a lease cancellation fee of $3.5 million, which will be amortized over the remaining 13-year lease term.
